purpose: Rank additional passive observations and explicitly authorized operator inspections by expected reduction in diagnostic hypothesis uncertainty, subject to declared cost, delay, risk and authority gates. This module is a read-only selector.

method.objective: Expected information gain in nats: I(H;O) = H(H) - sum_o P(o) H(H|o).
method.likelihood_contract: For every hypothesis, conditional probabilities across all declared outcomes sum to one; each likelihood table binds the stable sorted hypothesis-space digest, independent of the current prior.
method.prior_contract: Prior probabilities are finite, non-negative and sum to one. The stable hypothesis-space digest excludes probabilities; the prior-distribution digest includes them. Both are content-addressed separately.
method.calibration_contract: Likelihood model and calibration digests must be present. Their statistical calibration and signer/source trust are established upstream; digest shape alone does not prove model validity.

uncertainty_scenarios.description: Represent calibrated likelihood uncertainty as a frozen finite set of plausible scenarios. Each scenario supplies a normalized outcome likelihood table for the same hypothesis manifest.
uncertainty_scenarios.scenario_weights: Positive scenario weights sum to one and define the expected information gain across the declared uncertainty set.
uncertainty_scenarios.expected_information_gain: Weighted mean of scenario-specific expected information gain.
uncertainty_scenarios.worst_case_information_gain: Minimum scenario-specific expected information gain across the entire declared scenario set.
uncertainty_scenarios.eligibility: Require worst-case expected information gain over the entire frozen calibrated scenario set; a candidate also requires independently reviewed likelihood calibration before it is eligible. An optimistic weighted mean cannot compensate for an uninformative plausible scenario.
uncertainty_scenarios.qualification: A candidate with one point-estimate table may be ranked as a provisional point-model result but is not epistemically robust-qualified. Two or more distinct calibrated scenarios are required for that status.

risk_score.definition: risk_score_ppm is a declared policy score, not a calibrated probability or safety certification.
risk_score.evidence: Each candidate binds a separate risk_assessment_sha256 reference. The evidence content, method, scope, signer, review status, expiry and authority must be checked upstream.
risk_score.consequence: A missing, malformed or unreviewed risk-evidence reference makes the candidate ineligible.

observation_update.objective: After evidence is acquired by an authorized external system, update the hypothesis posterior. This is a read-only calculation and never acquires evidence or executes another action.
observation_update.candidate_binding: The update verifies the exact candidate ID and candidate manifest digest from the frozen selection catalogue; a candidate changed after selection is rejected.
observation_update.receipt_binding: The observation receipt SHA-256 and outcome ID are mandatory. The digest links the external receipt but does not authenticate its signer, sensor, timestamp or authority.
observation_update.posterior: For a single frozen point-likelihood table, compute p(h|o) proportional to p(h) times p(o|h). Multi-scenario sequential updates are blocked until a joint hypothesis × persistent-scenario posterior ledger is available; do not repeatedly marginalize fixed scenario weights as if uncertainty scenarios were independently redrawn for each observation.
observation_update.realized_information: Report prior entropy, posterior entropy, realized entropy reduction H(prior)-H(posterior), and KL(posterior || prior). Realized entropy reduction may be negative for an individual surprising outcome even though expected information gain is non-negative and KL is non-negative.
observation_update.scenario_uncertainty: Multi-scenario likelihoods support robust ranking and per-scenario posterior sensitivity reports. They do not authorize a sequential posterior update under fixed marginal scenario weights; the joint persistent scenario state is missing.

likelihood_calibration_review.requirement: Every candidate must carry an independent calibration-review receipt digest and a review state. Candidates not independently reviewed remain in the assessment ledger but are ineligible.
likelihood_calibration_review.receipt_binding: The candidate manifest and calibration catalogue bind the likelihood-model SHA, calibration SHA, reviewer receipt SHA and review state.
likelihood_calibration_review.qualification: A caller-supplied boolean and digest are not self-authenticating. The reviewer identity, competence, independence, report contents, signature, scope and revocation state must be verified by the upstream trust service.
likelihood_calibration_review.point_estimate_rule: A point-estimate likelihood table may be scored as a provisional diagnostic hypothesis, but it is not multi-scenario assessed and cannot qualify the robust evidence-selection track.

identity_contract.hypothesis_space_digest: SHA-256 over the sorted unique hypothesis IDs only. It is immutable across sequential posterior updates and binds every candidate likelihood table.
identity_contract.prior_distribution_digest: SHA-256 over the sorted hypothesis IDs and exact current probabilities. It changes whenever evidence changes the posterior and is separately bound into each selection portfolio.
identity_contract.candidate_binding: Candidate likelihood models bind the stable hypothesis-space digest, never a transient prior distribution.
identity_contract.portfolio_binding: Every ranking portfolio binds both the stable hypothesis-space digest and the exact prior-distribution digest used for that decision.
identity_contract.sequential_update: After applying an externally acquired observation, carry the returned posterior and observation ledger into a new selection round. Reuse of a candidate likelihood model is permitted only when the stable hypothesis-space digest still matches; every new round has a new prior-distribution digest.

chernoff_information.definition: C_ij = -log(min_s sum_o p(o|h_i)^s p(o|h_j)^(1-s)); report the minimum across all positive-prior pairs.
chernoff_information.grid: 100 fixed uniform intervals over s in [0,1]; grid is identical across candidates.
chernoff_information.robust_scenario_rule: Take the minimum pairwise Chernoff information over every validated scenario; scenario IDs, weights and outcome spaces are checked against the candidate manifest.
chernoff_information.relationship_to_eig: EIG measures average posterior entropy reduction for an observation; pairwise Chernoff information measures the separation of the hardest fault-mode pair under repeated observations.
chernoff_information.assumptions: The asymptotic error-exponent interpretation assumes repeated conditionally independent observations from a stationary likelihood regime. It is not a finite-sample error guarantee or one-shot confidence score.

passive_measurement.eligible_when: Read-only access is approved and an authority-evidence digest is attached.

operator_inspection.eligible_when: Policy permits inspection, an upstream authorization state is human_authorized, and an authority-evidence digest is attached.

controlled_perturbation.disposition: Always excluded by this selector. A separate safety case, hazard analysis, system owner and explicit control authority are required; this ranking module cannot authorize or execute one.

comparators.method: Keep current posterior and stop evidence acquisition.
Choose the eligible candidate with minimum declared cost; tie-break by candidate ID.
Choose the eligible candidate with greatest expected information gain, ignoring cost/delay/risk only after hard gates.
Choose eligible candidate with greatest EIG divided by one plus normalized cost.
Choose among the exact same eligible set using a frozen seed manifest.
Proposed selector: minimum expected information gain across all declared likelihood scenarios, adjusted by frozen cost, delay and risk scales, after hard authority/safety gates.

Choose the eligible candidate with the greatest weakest-pairwise Chernoff information across every declared likelihood scenario, using a frozen 100-interval s-grid and the identical hard-eligible candidate catalogue.

research_targets_not_achieved.target: At least 10% lower median cost-to-identification than the cheapest-eligible baseline at equal or better final diagnostic decision quality, on matched independent cases.
Higher realized posterior entropy reduction than seeded-random and cost-only baselines, with confidence intervals clustered by independent recording/engine run.
Zero unauthorized or controlled perturbations recommended; zero read-only selector execution or actuation.
No unique root-cause output when multiple hypotheses remain admissible after the selected evidence.
The selected evidence candidate retains positive worst-case expected information gain across every preregistered calibrated likelihood scenario, and exceeds the best matched baseline lower bound.
Empirical likelihood-scenario coverage is measured on independent episodes and no confirmatory outcome is used to construct the uncertainty set.
Across held-out observed outcomes, mean realized KL(posterior || prior) agrees with independently replayed expected information gain within a preregistered numerical tolerance.
100% of observation receipts reproduce the same posterior from the frozen candidate, prior and likelihood-scenario manifests.

Compare minimum worst-case pairwise Chernoff selection with risk-adjusted worst-case EIG, cost-only and seeded-random baselines on identical authorized candidate catalogues; demonstrate improved realized diagnosis error or cost-to-identification under independent repeated-evidence episodes.

Compare worst-case pairwise Chernoff selection against robust EIG, cheapest-only and seeded-random on identical authorized candidate sets; show lower realized diagnosis error or cost-to-identification on independent repeated-evidence episodes.

Implement and independently replay sequential Bayesian updates over the joint hypothesis × persistent-calibration-scenario posterior, with correct posterior scenario weights and no repeated-observation overconfidence.

evidence_boundaries.data_status: No physical observation likelihoods or benchmark-selected actions have been evaluated in this workstream.
evidence_boundaries.simulation_status: Synthetic contract tests verify entropy ranking and hard exclusions only; they do not establish real diagnostic utility or safety.
evidence_boundaries.authority_status: Authorization enum and digest are caller-supplied references. Signature verification, identity, scope, expiry, issuer authority and revocation are external mandatory checks.
evidence_boundaries.claim_ceiling: Read-only ranking contract and synthetic numerical behavior only; no evidence-acquisition execution, active-control result or physical validation claim.
evidence_boundaries.scenario_status: The Rust selector evaluates caller-supplied likelihood scenarios. It does not create or statistically validate the scenario set or establish its coverage of reality.
evidence_boundaries.risk_status: risk_score_ppm is a caller-supplied policy score bound to a digest reference; its underlying assessment is not authenticated or independently verified by this selector.
evidence_boundaries.realized_update_status: The Rust updater calculates a posterior from caller-supplied likelihoods and an external receipt digest; it does not collect or authenticate observations, and no physical observation has been evaluated.
evidence_boundaries.calibration_review: The source selector checks review receipt digest shape and a caller-supplied independent-review flag. It does not authenticate the reviewer or prove calibration validity; upstream signed verification remains mandatory.
evidence_boundaries.chernoff_status: This implementation computes a finite-grid separation estimate from caller-supplied likelihoods. It does not validate conditional independence, calibrate likelihoods or guarantee finite-sample fault-isolation error.
evidence_boundaries.scenario_sequential_updates: Multi-scenario candidate ranking is implemented; sequential Bayesian posterior updates are blocked until the joint hypothesis-scenario posterior is represented and replayed.
